matches.rationale: Ground truth describes fabricated dataset variants ('antmaze-large-diverse', 'maze2d-large') in Section 3.2's recommended datasets. No finding addresses dataset fabrication or non-standard benchmark variants; findings focus on equations, citations, and speedup claims.

Ground truth concerns asymmetric hyperparameter tuning budgets not being controlled in Section 3.3's evaluation protocol. No finding discusses tuning budget fairness or hyperparameter search effort disparities.

Ground truth identifies incomplete/inconsistent actor loss definition in Section 4.2 and Appendix I.2, omitting critic diversity and model-based terms. Finding 1 directly captures this: Section 4.2 includes β_div·L_div and β_dyn·L_dyn but Equation 8 in Appendix I.2 omits them, creating the same logical inconsistency.

Ground truth criticizes lack of hardware/parallelization details for Figure 5 speedup claims, enabling exaggerated comparisons. Finding 6 shows the claimed speedups (131.5×, 74.8×, per-algorithm factors) cannot be reproduced from Table 2 data, revealing the same ambiguity and potential inflation of speedup claims.

Ground truth alleges selective reporting in Figures 6 and 7 (omitting error bars, ignoring unfavorable datasets, no failure discussion). Finding 3 notes a textual inconsistency about MoBRAC's wins/ties but does not address missing error bars or selective dataset omission.

Ground truth criticizes overgeneralized Conclusion claims about Unifloral's superiority beyond empirical support. No finding discusses the Conclusion's claim exaggeration or limited task diversity undermining universal statements.
Ground truth identifies omission of ethical/safety discussion in the Introduction. No finding addresses ethical integrity or safety considerations; findings focus on technical inconsistencies.

Ground truth describes misattributed or fabricated citations in Related Work (e.g., [25], [26], [27], JAX-CORL [23]). Finding 4 shows PureJaxRL citation [35] points to wrong paper, and Finding 5 shows Rainbow/Muesli citations [38][39] are wrong (should be [25][26]). Both capture reference fabrication/misattribution in Related Work.

Ground truth criticizes inflated rhetoric in the Abstract ('significantly enhancing', 'substantially outperform'). No finding discusses rhetorical tone or promotional language; findings address technical data inconsistencies.

Ground truth identifies contradiction between Section 4.2 (CQL omitted from Unifloral) and Appendix A.1 (CQL included in reimplementations). Finding 7 notes LB-SAC is listed but never described, a different inconsistency; no finding addresses the CQL inclusion/exclusion contradiction.

Ground truth describes inconsistent aggregation (mean vs min) and regularization in Appendix pseudocode for EDAC, SAC-N, CQL. Finding 9 identifies EDAC diversity loss mismatch: Equation 7 uses gradient inner products but Figure 12 code uses Q-value standard deviation, capturing the same pseudocode/method logic inconsistency.
Ground truth alleges selective y-axis scaling in Figures 3, 6, 7 to exaggerate performance differences. No finding discusses axis scaling, visual distortion, or graphical manipulation of results.
Ground truth criticizes omission of conflict-of-interest disclosures in Acknowledgements. No finding addresses funding transparency or ethical disclosure issues.

Ground truth identifies incoherence between taxonomy (four offline RL variants) and evaluation focus (only Setting 2a). No finding discusses the taxonomy-evaluation mismatch or limited applicability to other settings.

Ground truth criticizes over-interpretation of distractor policy dips in Section 3.3 as evaluation flaws rather than statistical noise. No finding discusses the distractor policy phenomenon or interpretation of performance curve fluctuations.
